logical_storage_model.N: scalar count over tensors that have at least one protected coordinate and therefore retain a dense bool mask
logical_storage_model.u: fraction of N protected in the accumulated union
logical_storage_model.exclusions: Python/dict/torch serialization overhead, allocator overhead, transient per-tensor device copies and transient diff/topk buffers
logical_storage_model.scope: Formula is source-structural. Numerical scenarios below substitute total public BF16 model scalar count for N, so they are full-mask-domain scenarios rather than measured actual mask-domain memory. Independent support overlap is a scenario, not an observation.

mask_construction_source_structure.description: cur_sd remains live while prev_model/prev_sd is loaded, so two full BF16 model-state tensor payloads can coexist before per-tensor diff processing.
mask_construction_source_structure.scope: Source-structure tensor-payload estimate, not measured process RSS. Additional model/Python/transient buffers are excluded.

runtime_transfer_warning: Each _compute_loss moves full per-tensor protected flat indices and reference weights to param.device before ZeRO-3 partition filtering. Quantify actual host/device placement and transfer volume with a live profile before calling this H2D overhead.
